messages.content: Predict a person’s food allocation in a dictator game conducted in their settlement with a local interpreter. The person is given 10 cups of the current food and owns all of them. They physically divide the cups into what they keep and what they donate to another, unspecified person in the same camp or boma. They may keep any whole number from 0 to 10 cups; the remaining 10 minus that number are donated. They may take their retained goods home after the study. To keep choices anonymous, donated food is placed in a large opaque bag and later redistributed in the local community. There is no recipient veto. The current food and grams per cup are given below. Predict the number of cups this person keeps, not the number donated. Output only an integer from 0 to 10, in cups.
